The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across trials with zero exceptions recorded in the adhoc hermes gpt-5.5 run. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success via test_legacy_pytest_suite in test_output.py, completing in 0.31 seconds. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in the weighted-risk formula to ensure judge_reward (currently 0.79) aligns more closely with the perfect verifier score.
